metric: paired MAE, candidate minus comparator; negative is better
primary_test: two-sided paired sign flip of chronological target-month blocks; independent symmetric blocks assumed
sensitivity_test: two-sided paired sign flip of individual target months
confidence_intervals: small-sample cluster-t interval with block scores and df=blocks-1, plus descriptive moving time-block and conditional region bootstraps
multiple_testing: Holm across every available point comparison in this registry, separately for each p-value method
limitations: previously inspected history and repeated model selection
three-month blocks do not prove independence
few time blocks yield coarse p-values and unstable confidence intervals
region resampling conditions on fixed calendar months
latest external snapshots do not establish historical as-of availability
future_rule: save paired predictions, fixed config, source vintages, comparator and protocol before scoring; append all candidates, including failures
